limits: Optional glass surface; omit pastel palette, blur and universal KPI shell.

contribution: Developer shell task regions; code/UI font separation and focus continuity
limits: Do not adopt dark-by-default, inconsistent row heights or generic large radii.

contribution: Navigation current state, collapse labels and contextual empty recovery
limits: No fixed 5–7 module limit, fixed sidebar widths or forced table-to-card rewrite.

contribution: Palette category/scope, keyboard result selection, Escape/return focus
limits: No forced dark theme, mandatory modal shell or universal destructive confirmation.

contribution: Metric anatomy/unit/period/source, filter scope, card-local failure
limits: No forced 4 KPI columns or invented first-screen summaries.

contribution: Relief must retain explicit boundaries and focus indication
limits: Neumorphic style only if requested/task fit; no copied shadows or universal low-risk categorization.

contribution: Platform theme resources, high contrast/text scaling, opaque content surfaces
limits: Windows visual treatment does not implement Mica or platform integration in Iced.

contribution: Pane geometry min/default/max, scroll ownership, recoverable collapsed context
limits: No automatic layout persistence or fixed 1280 threshold.

contribution: Board drag feedback and non-drag movement; distinguish card controls
limits: Do not introduce board to task-first product; no blanket flash/rotation animation.

contribution: Separate command/operation context, output and lifecycle; constrain long logs
limits: No invented CPU/RAM metrics or equation process exit=success.

contribution: Utility drag/control separation, pin/focus policy, position recovery
limits: No tiny 9–10px copy, automatic always-on-top or persistence implementation claim.

contribution: Task-shaped workbench with distinct selected/open/modified and pane recovery
limits: No dark palette adoption, fixed rail widths, tiny 10px labels or mandatory full shell.

contribution: Setting scope, edited/tested/saved distinction, validation and sensitive display
limits: No network tests, persistence or credential plumbing authorized by a design pattern.

contribution: Column hierarchy, sort/filter and selection scope, bulk action consequences
limits: Do not equate failed data with empty or impose sticky columns everywhere.

contribution: Composer/stream/tool result ownership, stop state and inspector adaptation
limits: Chat is a candidate task pattern, not replacement for Ox agent-first workspace.

contribution: Retro style as explicit direction; preserve usable typography/focus
limits: Reject automatic 8–9pt text and fake native integration from appearance.

contribution: Thematic neon only where requested and legible; reduced motion
limits: No all-caps tiny labels, scanlines, invented telemetry or neon for operational Ox default.

contribution: Bold visual language can coexist with stable targets and hierarchy
limits: No mandatory offset shadows, interaction translation, saturated brand replacement.

contribution: Soft surface direction must retain contrast, focus and readable density
limits: No universal 30px radii/multiple shadows or assumed audience preference.
